description: A cheaper flyer stapled over the big banner's ankle by someone with a rougher agenda — same green, ragged edges, printed in a back room by the look of it. A gloved fist closes around a single city block. NORTH OF HERE, THE RENT IS BLOOD AND THE RETURN IS EVERYTHING. Below, hand-lettered: "The good ground's already spoken for. Found a crew, take a corner, and maybe — maybe — earn a look at the north, where the real money sleeps."
name: a hand-stapled corp recruitment flyer
